The speaker invites viewers to subscribe to the ABC News YouTube channel.
Subscribing will provide access to more videos, show highlights, and live event coverage.
Viewers should click on the right side to subscribe.
The ABC News app is available for downloading.
Downloading the ABC News app provides breaking news alerts.

assumptions.text: Audiences value timely news updates and want to stay informed.
Viewers trust the credibility of ABC News and its content delivery methods.
Clicking on the 'right' refers to a visible button or link within the video interface.
Subscribing to the channel increases viewer engagement and loyalty.
The ABC News app enhances user experience by delivering real-time notifications.
